title: Owner looks up Cedar Health company details
userProblem: I need the full details for Cedar Health — what industry are they in and which region do they operate in?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches companies, finds Cedar Health, and answers with its industry (Healthcare) and region (UK), quoting the record.

assertions.description: Agent must look the company up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to companies.
Answer names the right company, industry, and region.
A lookup must not mutate data.

rationale: Baseline green scenario for company lookup by an owner persona. Verifies read path across all record types.
